data.text:
CEBU CITY TRAFFIC ADVISORY: SOLEMN FOOT PROCESSION 2026

LOOK: The Cebu City Transportation Office (CCTO) announced temporary road closures and expected heavy traffic for the Fiesta Señor 2026 Solemn Foot Procession on Saturday, January 17.

The procession will begin at the Basilica Minore del Santo Niño at 1 p.m. It will proceed to Osmeña Boulevard, D. Jakosalem Street, Magallanes Street, Borromeo Street, L. Kilat Street, N. Bacalso Avenue, and V. Rama Avenue. It will head north on B. Rodriguez Street up to Fuente Circle before returning eastward to the Basilica via Osmeña Boulevard.

Assembly time for participants is at noon, with road closures starting at 10 a.m. | CCTO via Ian Peter Guanzon #CDNDigital #Sinulog2026 #SinulogFestival

Read more of Sinulog updates here: https://t.co/yEARtZG0YV
